mechanics.process_surface: the invention proposer (the creative slot of the frontier cycle)

source_verification.CC1: CANNOT_CHECK - no primary source fetched this pass. From-training sketch: Lenat's AM (1976-77) generated mathematical concepts/conjectures via heuristics over a frame representation; Fajtlowicz's Graffiti (late 1980s) generated graph-theoretic inequality conjectures, some publication-grade, filtered against counterexample databases; recent neural conjecturing produces candidate statements from learned models. Verbatim claims, exact mechanisms and evaluation records must be verified by the nearest-work lane before any comparative sentence is published.

mechanics.preconditions: A generator over a statement space; a FILTER that kills bad candidates cheaply (counterexamples, triviality checks); a valuation of interestingness (AM's weakest, most criticized component).
mechanics.mechanism: Generate candidate statements the corpus does not contain; filter mechanically where possible; surface survivors for expensive validation. The parents' documented lesson (pending verification): generation is cheap, VALUATION is the bottleneck, and self-scored interestingness drifts.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: Existence proof that machine-generated conjectures can reach publication grade (Graffiti's record, pending primary verification).
mechanics.cost: Candidate flood; valuation drift; survivorship bias in retrospective reporting of the parents' successes.
failure_modes: Self-scored interestingness becoming a de-facto authority (the exact leak Orion's floor-0 rule exists to prevent).
Counting filtered survivors as discoveries before target validation.
Retrospective cherry-picking of the parents' hit lists (why primary verification is mandatory before citing their success rates).
mechanics.scope: Proposal generation only. Nothing in these parents addresses authority transport of an accepted conjecture into a larger derivation.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: The pluggable creative slot of the frontier cycle (docs/CONTAINMENT_HYPOTHESIS.md Part 2b); src/rakl/recursive_solver.py governed invention: proposals enter at authority floor 0 with non-empty obligations, only after research saturation + decomposition exhaustion (LIFT rule).
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: What Orion eats is the FILTER discipline, not the generators: cheap mechanical falsification (counterexample search) before any expensive obligation discharge. FALSIFIER for the transfer: if adding a cheap-falsification stage before kernel discharge does not reduce cost per admitted bridge at equal admission quality on a real frontier-cycle workload, the stage is dead weight.

mechanics.process_surface: decomposition and analogy routing (the classical parent of the whole fiber discipline)

source_verification.CC1: CANNOT_CHECK - no primary source fetched this pass. From-training sketch: Polya (How to Solve It, 1945; Mathematics and Plausible Reasoning, 1954) systematized: understand the problem, devise a plan via related/analogous solved problems, decompose, generalize/specialize, work backward from the goal, and treat plausible reasoning as distinct from demonstrative proof. Verbatim formulations pending nearest-work verification.

mechanics.preconditions: A solver (human, in the source) able to recognize structural kinship with solved problems.
mechanics.mechanism: Route a new problem through: restatement, analogous-solved-problem retrieval, decomposition into subproblems, backward reasoning from the goal, and explicit separation of plausible from demonstrative steps.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: The classical articulation of exactly the moves Orion mechanizes: fiber decomposition, analogue/method-transfer matrices, backward corridor, and the plausible-vs-demonstrative split (proposal vs authority).
mechanics.cost: None mechanical - it is a discipline, not machinery.
failure_modes: Treating Polya's plausible reasoning as if it carried demonstrative force (the authority leak, named by the parent itself).
Analogy by surface resemblance (the parent warns; our structural-witness requirement is the mechanization of that warning).
mechanics.scope: Human mathematical practice; transfers as DESIGN VOCABULARY and as the honesty benchmark - a claim that Orion's decomposition/analogy loop is novel must survive comparison with a 1945 articulation.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: Atomization + context fibers (skills/rakl-core workflow B-C), analogue/method-transfer matrix (D-E), backward corridor (docs/EPISTEMIC_PATHFINDING_AND_GAP_COMPLETION.md), proposal-vs-authority split (constitutional).
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Nothing to import - the obligation runs the OTHER way: Paper I/V nearest-work sections must cite Polya as the classical parent of the decomposition/analogy discipline and claim only the MECHANIZATION + GOVERNANCE as delta. FALSIFIER of the delta wording: any Orion claim sentence that would be true of Polya's discipline as practiced by a careful human is not a novelty sentence.

mechanics.process_surface: composition search over the derivation space (the span-navigation half of Part 2a)

source_verification.CC1: CANNOT_CHECK - no primary source fetched this pass. From-training sketch: guided search (MCTS or learned policy/value) over formal proof states, with the proof assistant as the transition oracle; AlphaProof-class systems reported IMO-level results (2024) with a Lean verifier in the loop. UNPUBLISHED INTERNALS ARE CANNOT_CHECK AND ARE NOT GUESSED - only published statements may be cited after the nearest-work lane verifies them.

mechanics.preconditions: A formal environment whose states are checkable (the kernel as oracle); a search budget; optionally a learned guidance policy.
mechanics.mechanism: Navigate the exponential composition space with guided search; every accepted step is kernel-checked, so guidance quality affects COST, never soundness - structurally the same wager as Part 2b's frontier cycle.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: Evidence (pending primary verification) that kernel-in-the-loop search can reach frontier-adjacent mathematics; confirms the span-not-inventory reading of Part 2a at scale.
mechanics.cost: Enormous compute in the reported systems; guidance training data; opaque proposal policies.
failure_modes: Attributing soundness to the policy instead of the kernel (the parents themselves do not make this error; press coverage does).
Benchmark-shaped search: competition problems have known-solvable structure; frontier research problems do not come with that guarantee.

For Orion: importing the search pattern without the obstruction layer - guided recombination at distance is exactly where jointly-unrealizable gluings arise (Part 2a), and a kernel rejects a wrong PROOF but cannot reject a wrong PROBLEM DECOMPOSITION.
mechanics.scope: Formal proof search with mechanical verification. The parents optimize single-theorem search; none maintain a persistent, authority-typed, obstruction-preserving space across problems.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: derivation.py forward closure + support_solver routes as the (currently unguided) composition search; certificates.py as the kernel-authority binding; the missing piece on our side is any guidance policy at all - and the missing piece on theirs is the persistent governed space. The deltas are complementary, not competitive.
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Candidate import: guidance-as-cost-reducer with zero authority (a policy may reorder the corridor, never license an edge). FALSIFIER: a guided arm that changes WHICH derivations are accepted (not just how fast) has leaked authority into guidance and must be rejected; a guided arm that does not reduce expansions at equal solve set is dead weight.
